{'text': 'Apple TV今日公開咗即將播出嘅動畫歷險劇集《格林姊妹》(The Sisters Grimm)第二季嘅預告片，喺下面可以睇到。', 'translation': 'Apple TV today released a trailer for the second season of its upcoming animated adventure series The Sisters Grimm, which you can watch below.'}

{'text': '《格林姊妹》將於10月2日回歸', 'translation': 'The Sisters Grimm returns on October 2.'}

{'text': '《格林姊妹》將於10月2日喺Apple TV回歸，距離第一季首播剛好差一日就滿一週年。', 'translation': 'The Sisters Grimm returns to Apple TV on October 2, almost exactly one year to the day from its first season premiere.'}

{'text': '呢部動畫歷險劇集改編自Michael Buckley嘅同名紐約時報暢銷系列小說，講述兩姊妹喺一個住滿童話故事人物嘅小鎮上穿梭，同英雄同奸角打交道，同時調查佢哋父母失蹤嘅謎團。', 'translation': 'The animated adventure series is based on the New York Times bestselling book series of the same name by Michael Buckley, and follows two sisters who travel through a town filled with fairy tale characters, deal with heroes and villains, and investigate the mystery surrounding their missing parents.'}

{'text': '劇集嘅配音陣容包括Abubakar Salim（《Jamestown》）、Ariel Winter（《摩登家庭》）、Leah Newman（《Kindergarten: The Musical》）等等，佢嘅第一季共七集，喺爛番茄獲得100%嘅影評人新鮮度。', 'translation': 'The voice cast for the series includes Abubakar Salim (Jamestown), Ariel Winter (Modern Family), Leah Newman (Kindergarten: The Musical), and more. Its first season, which consists of seven episodes, currently holds a 100% critics score on Rotten Tomatoes.'}

{'text': '喺下面睇《格林姊妹》第二季嘅預告片：', 'translation': 'Watch the trailer for The Sisters Grimm season 2 below:'}

{'text': 'Apple TV月費為14.99美元，亦可以透過Apple One組合訂閱。平台提供多套人氣劇集同電影，包括《Ted Lasso》、《Severance》、《The Studio》、《The Morning Show》、《Shrinking》同《Silo》。', 'translation': 'Apple TV costs $14.99 per month and is also available as part of an Apple One bundle. The platform offers a number of hit shows and movies, including Ted Lasso, Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.'}
